title: Pounchi khaber jo khaime mein abbas margaye
body:
Pounchi khaber jo khaime mein abbas margaye
saidaniyoun ke sunte hi chehre utar gaye
1. ab tak palat ke aaye na nehre furaat se
ammu ko mere der huwi ghaat par gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
2. bazoo huwe khalam to na tha dil ka kuch alam
mashkeeza chid gaya to alamdar margaye
<<DIVIDER>>
3. karbobala mein akber-o-asghar ki shakl mein
sab fatima ke haar ke moti bhikar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
4. bachoun se ro ke baali sakina ne yeh kaha
ab kya milega paani chacha jaan margaye
<<DIVIDER>>
5. bole yeh shai behan se ke zainab ghazab huwa
jis par tha humko naaz wo abbas margaye
